fixtures.name: document_medium
fixtures.text: Vector search systems convert text into dense numerical embeddings so that semantically related passages land close together in the vector space. A retrieval pipeline typically embeds every document offline, stores the vectors in an index, and at query time embeds the incoming question with the same model. The distance between the query vector and each document vector then ranks the candidates, and the highest scoring passages are returned to the caller for downstream use.
